summary: Scilex Holding Co filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to disclose a dividend of Dream Bowl Meme Coin I tokens to eligible equity holders. The dividend is five tokens per share of common stock held, payable beginning May 26, 2026, to record holders as of April 30, 2026, including holders of common stock, certain warrants, convertible notes, and Series A Preferred Stock. The board retains flexibility to change dates. No price/share, premium, or advisor is stated. This special dividend of crypto tokens is non-routine but does not fit typical M&A or restructuring categories; it is classified as 'Other'.
